facts.text: Snow left Palisades Tahoe (8,010 ft) and Ward Creek 3 (6,750 ft) 15 to 32 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Palisades Tahoe
evidence.detail: left May 10; earlier seasons: June 17 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 25 (2025)

evidence.name: Ward Creek 3
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: June 13 (2023), May 26 (2024), May 20 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Palisades Tahoe (8,010 ft) and Ward Creek 3 (6,750 ft).

evidence.name: Palisades Tahoe
evidence.detail: 10.6 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 74.6 in (2023), 34.1 in (2024), 43.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Ward Creek 3
evidence.detail: 18.0 in on May 11; earlier seasons: 70.2 in (2023), 44.3 in (2024), 41.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 17 and June 11, carried from the melt-out dates at Palisades Tahoe (8,010 ft) and Ward Creek 3 (6,750 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Palisades Tahoe
evidence.detail: melted out May 10, 91 ft below the pass; points to April 19 to June 3

evidence.name: Ward Creek 3
evidence.detail: melted out April 24, 1,351 ft below the pass; points to April 16 to June 18
